_comment: Each entry must name the exact case id, say why the difference is not a defect,
and classify it as spec-ambiguous or spec-unique-answer-{Rust,Python}-bug.
The file starts empty on purpose: the first gate 3 run must fail until every
difference is understood. A stale entry (its case now matches) also fails the gate.
